statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ZMod m),
  let A := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod m)).filter (fun x => IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit (N-x))
  let F := A.filter (fun x => N-x=x)
  let K : Matrix (ZMod m) (ZMod m) ℂ := fun x y => if x ∈ A ∧ y=N-x then 1 else 0
  (K*K = Matrix.diagonal (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) ∧
    2 * Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace K.mulVecLin 1) = A.card+F.card ∧
    2 * Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace K.mulVecLin (-1)) = A.card-F.card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0005 · 计算单位反射矩阵的平方及其正负空间维数
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0005 · Compute the square and the two signed dimensions of the unit reflection matrix

brief.zh: 在完整剩余系上以零填充，仅保留 x 与 N−x 都为单位的坐标。每个二循环贡献一个正方向和一个负方向，每个不动点贡献一个正方向。
brief.en: Use the whole residue ring with zeros outside the retained coordinates where both x and N−x are units. Each transposition contributes one direction of each sign and each fixed point contributes one positive direction.
